summary_1line: Episodes recount Nandi’s divine birth and elevation, Kala Bhairava’s origin, several Shiva legends, and stories of devotion rewarded by Shiva.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shiva and Parvati appear before the meditating boy Nandi in the forest and Shiva places his hand on Nandi’s head in blessing.
The fierce three‑eyed Bhairava bursts forth from Shiva’s cry, brandishing a trident and drum as the heavens and earth tremble.
The grieving Ahuki leaps into the funeral fire beside her slain husband as Shiva and Parvati reveal themselves before the flames.
